findings.chapter: Chapter 5 / From Workload to Model Selection
findings.evidence: "Per-request context/KV cost at 9.2K input — named 70B checkpoint with GQA‑8 (e.g. Llama‑3 70B) ~3.0 GB (FP16 KV cache, initial) 9,200 × 0.33 MB; 80 layers × 8 KV heads × head_dim 128 at FP16 (327,680 B/token) [1P][DERIVED]"
findings.issue: The arithmetic is correct, but the row labels the result [1P][DERIVED] while the 9,200-token context is a canonical-scenario input, not a first-party model-card value. The derivation mixes a first-party geometry (Llama-3 70B GQA) with a canonical-scenario context length. The book's own mixed-input convention (stated on page 109) says the non-canonical input should govern the provenance, so this row should be [canonical scenario][DERIVED] or [ILLUSTRATIVE][DERIVED], not [1P][DERIVED].
findings.fix_instruction: Relabel the row to reflect the mixed input: [canonical scenario][DERIVED] for the 9.2K context combined with the named GQA geometry, or split the row into a per-token [1P][DERIVED] value and a 9.2K-context [canonical scenario][DERIVED] value.

findings.evidence: "...the ~436 GB KV budget (640 − 140 − 64: 640 − 140 = 500 GB in §5.3(b), less the ~64 GB runtime reserve that Ch 7 §7.3 subtracts) supports ~436/24.9 ≈ 17.5...". The Preface convention (p.24) states explicitly: "Do not repeat a chapter number after the chapter name — write Ch. 8 § 3 or § 8.3.3, not Ch. 8 § 8.3.3."
findings.issue: Cross-reference form violation: "Ch 7 §7.3" repeats the chapter number inside the section reference after the chapter is already named, exactly the pattern the Preface forbids. Every other named-chapter reference in the visible text complies (e.g. "Ch 8 §3.3" p.52, "Ch 8 §3.4" p.55, "Ch 8 §3, Table 8-1" pp.157, 159).
findings.fix_instruction: Rewrite as "Ch 7 § 3" or "§ 7.3"; sweep the manuscript for any other "Ch N §N.M" occurrences.
